sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.why: Possible strain: sleep is {delta} {unit} below your usual, more than 2 standard deviations. Watch applies when it lasts 3 nights.
sleep_hours.action: Protect a full sleep period tonight. If it continues, contact the flight surgeon or crew support.
sleep_hours.howToMeasure: Log the hours you slept each morning.
sleep_hours.whyItMatters: Judged against your own baseline, not an 8-hour rule. Short sleep slows reactions and can add to strain.

mood.label: Mood
mood.why: Possible strain: mood is {delta} {unit} below your usual, more than 2 standard deviations. Watch applies when it lasts 3 days.
mood.action: Take a short break and talk with the crew. If it continues, contact the flight surgeon or crew support.
mood.howToMeasure: Rate your mood once a day from 1 (low) to 5 (high).
mood.whyItMatters: Mood changes against your own usual can show strain early. NASA notes that some crew report rising stress in the second half of a mission.

reaction_ms.label: Reaction check
reaction_ms.why: Possible strain: your reaction check is {delta} {unit} slower than your usual, more than 2 standard deviations.
reaction_ms.action: Repeat the reaction check after rest. If it stays slow, contact the flight surgeon or crew support.
reaction_ms.howToMeasure: Do the 1 to 2 minute reaction check: tap when the prompt appears. The result is your median reaction time in milliseconds.
reaction_ms.whyItMatters: Slower reactions than your own usual can show tiredness or strain. NASA lists reaction tests among its monitoring tools.

social_contact.label: Social contact
social_contact.why: Possible strain: time with crew or family is {delta} {unit} below your usual, more than 2 standard deviations.
social_contact.action: Plan some time with the crew or a call home. If it continues, contact the flight surgeon or crew support.
social_contact.howToMeasure: Log the minutes you spent with crew or family today.
social_contact.whyItMatters: Falling contact over a week can be an early sign of strain during isolation and confinement.

combined_strain.why: Several signs of strain together for 2 days.
combined_strain.action: Contact the flight surgeon or crew support.
